items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I see John Williams. Wait a minute. Aw, it couldn’t be. It was. Star Wars Johnny Williams on piano, playing bebop.

ctx.x: Jerry Hey and all those guys. We worked together. Jerry – the piano player, Williams – Larry Williams was there on [?] Montreux.
Larry. All of them I.U. people.
